perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, the available information is limited to this conversation:

I greeted/was greeted by RECOMMENDER, then asked if there were any new movies worth watching. I heard RECOMMENDER:
- Ask what movie genres I was interested in.
- Say they thought *Bright* (2017) was really good, even without the back story.
- Say they saw *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017).
- Say *Bright* (2017) is a Netflix original starring Will Smith.
- Recommend *Coco* (2017) if I like animation or kids movies.
- Recommend *Wonder Woman* (2017) if I like action.
- Say they personally will watch a horror movie then an animation/kids movie to calm their nerves.
- Say they watched *It* (2017) in theatres and I might like it.
- Ask if *It* was not scary enough for me.
- Say they haven’t seen *Armageddon* (1997), might check it out, and have been told to watch that and *Braveheart* (1995).

I also know my own statements/actions in the conversation:
- I like all kinds of movies and will watch a kids movie followed by a horror flick.
- I am not a *Star Wars* fan; I made a comment that I did see that / may have to watch that one.
- I initially hadn’t heard of *Bright*.
- I have *Coco* on my short list and may check it out tonight.
- I have heard great things about *Wonder Woman* and agreed that horror-then-animation is a good way to do it.
- I fell asleep to *It* recently and need to watch it again.
- I was just really tired, and I am weird about sleeping while watching movies.
- I love *Armageddon* (1997) — after first typing *Waiting for Armageddon* (2009) — and it puts me out in about 10 minutes every time.
